title: M1 red-team adversarial test report
principle: Each case asserts the chain REJECTS or correctly handles the attack. Tests use only exported l1chain APIs; no public API was modified and no existing test was weakened.

adversarial_cases.scenario: Sender balance B=1000 submits two txs each spending 600 (>B/2), summing 1200 (>B) in ONE block.
adversarial_cases.expected_handling: AddBlock and ApplyBlock reject with ErrInsufficientBalance; canonical head and all balances remain unchanged (atomic, no partial/negative/overflow balance).

adversarial_cases.scenario: A validly secp256k1-signed tx (nonce 0) is applied via ApplyTx twice.
adversarial_cases.expected_handling: Second application rejected with ErrBadNonce; balance debited exactly once; sender nonce advances to 1.

adversarial_cases.scenario: Tx signed by key X but From overwritten to address(Y).
adversarial_cases.expected_handling: wallet.Verify returns false; AddBlock (verifySig=wallet.Verify) rejects with ErrBadSig; head does not advance.

adversarial_cases.scenario: Well-formed block whose hash does not meet its declared Difficulty (Difficulty bumped to 240 without re-mining).
Correct txs but wrong Header.StateRoot (re-mined), and separately wrong Header.MerkleRoot (re-mined).
adversarial_cases.expected_handling: StateRoot tamper rejected with ErrBadStateRoot; MerkleRoot tamper rejected with ErrBadTxRoot.

adversarial_cases.scenario: Head branch A (2 blocks crediting addr(2)) vs heavier competing branch B (3 blocks crediting addr(3)).
adversarial_cases.expected_handling: Canonical head switches to B (heavier cumulative difficulty); branch-A credit to addr(2) is 0 in State() (no cross-branch state leakage); addr(3)=375, addr(1)=625, miner=3*BlockReward; abandoned tip still retrievable by hash but non-canonical.

adversarial_cases.scenario: Transfer with Value(5000) > balance(1000) and Value = math.MaxUint64.
adversarial_cases.expected_handling: Both rejected with ErrInsufficientBalance; sender balance stays 1000 (no underflow), recipient stays 0 (no overflow wraparound), sender nonce not advanced by rejected txs.

adversarial_cases.scenario: Block whose claimed StateRoot credits the miner an EXTRA BlockReward (2x total).
adversarial_cases.expected_handling: Engine re-derives the correct single-reward state; claimed root mismatches, rejected with ErrBadStateRoot; head does not advance.

summary.note: No adversarial case revealed a defect. The chain rejected every modeled attack with the expected sentinel error and preserved atomicity/state integrity.
